verdict:
**QA Review — issues found (not CLEAN)**

**1. UI overlap/clipping issues (must fix)**
- **"Skip — use default yard" link collides with sidebar content.** At the bottom-left, the skip link is rendered on top of the "Patios & Paths" section — it visually overlaps the "Patio" list item, creating a garbled, strikethrough-looking cluster of text. Looks broken.
- **"Patio" list item is clipped.** The last sidebar item is cut off by the bottom of the sidebar/status bar, so only the top half of the label is visible. Combined with the overlapping skip link, the bottom of the sidebar looks glitched.
- Suggest: give the sidebar enough bottom padding (or make it scrollable) so the skip link and last category don't collide with the status bar.

**2. Comprehension in 5 seconds — mostly good**
- The onboarding modal is clear and well-structured: "Welcome to Backyard Designer 3D," Step 1 of 2, two large shape cards with a selected state, and a prominent "Next Step" CTA. A new user would understand the task immediately. ✅

**3. Minor / polish items**
- **"FPS: —" in the status bar** suggests a metric that never loaded; hide it or show a value.
- **Bottom toolbar spacing is uneven** — Tape Measure → Innovate buttons have large irregular gaps, and the scale bar + "Sun" button sit wedged between the Terrain/Sun & Shadow panel and the tool row. Group them consistently.
- **"Basic mode: essential tools only" tooltip** floats mid-canvas with no clear anchor; attach it to the Basic/Advanced toggle or dismiss it automatically.
- The "Getting Started" callout has a close (×) affordance overlapping its rounded corner slightly — acceptable but could be nudged inward.

**Summary:** The onboarding flow itself is clear, but the bottom-left area is visibly broken — the "Skip — use default yard" link overlaps the clipped "Patio" sidebar item, and a few minor polish issues (FPS placeholder, uneven bottom toolbar spacing) remain.
